skills.description: Read registry images: Images lists the org's container repositories, read live from the OCI catalog and filtered server-side to the org's namespace — the page can only ever hold the caller's own images..
skills.name: registry_images

skills.description: Read registry packages: Packages lists the org's npm packages — `<org>` and `@<org>/…` — from the npm registry's search index, optionally narrowed by a query within that scope..
skills.name: registry_packages

skills.description: Read registry projects: Projects lists the namespaces the caller can see with what each holds: the org's slug, its repository count on the OCI catalog, and its package count on the npm registry..
skills.name: registry_projects

skills.description: Read registry status: Status reports whether the OCI and npm registries are reachable and, when the OCI half is auth-gated, which token realm its challenge advertises — an honest lens for "is the registry plane up", never a fabricated ok..
skills.name: registry_status

skills.description: Read registry tags: Tags lists one org-owned repository's tags, read live from the OCI registry..
skills.name: registry_tags
